corrections_from_live_validation: Mainland China OSM levels are mapped as 4 province, 5 city/prefecture, and 6 county/district. Level 8 townships are not labelled as counties.
Unknown administrative levels retain boundaries without inferred labels; the importer can declare their actual level.
The lake label could be placed using an internal projected anchor and 14 pt text.
Automatic river labels are screened by their longest continuous visible segment. Missing user-requested names raise an error instead of being silently omitted.
remaining_limits: Photon and Overpass are third-party services without a guarantee of response time, availability, or coverage.
Narrow extents and curved or fragmented rivers may prevent placement of all suggested names. QA returns failed with a diagnostic preview instead of claiming completion.
No complete new county response was obtained after correcting the query. County online end-to-end acceptance remains incomplete; deterministic unit checks verify the level mapping.
Local GeoJSON import and the bundled example were separately verified through actual rendering during the original development process.
